about: One entry per app. The chat named here is the only chat that works on that app. A chat reads its own entry before it starts and writes it back when it stops. status: needs = waiting on Jerry; review = finished work to look at; open = work outstanding; clear = nothing waiting; no-chat = no chat owns this app yet. repo: the GitHub repo an app lives in when it is not this one; blank means daraja-apps.
